reference.pathophysiology: Entheseal HLA-B27 inflammation ossifies sacroiliacs and spine into bamboo with uveitis, aortitis, apical fibrosis and gut-skin links; psoriatic adds DIP dactylitis nails, reactive follows dysentery or urethritis, and enteropathic tracks bowel activity.
additionalDifferentials: Mechanical versus rheumatoid versus DISH versus infective by rest response CCP age-flow and cultures
Ankylosing versus psoriatic versus reactive versus enteropathic by skin urethra gut and B27
Aortic rheumatic versus ankylosing by history and root imaging
additionalInvestigations: X-ray sacroiliac grading with MRI marrow oedema
Eye slit-lamp with stool and ECG screens
